dct_title_s: King County, Washington : urban growth area, 2002
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington urban growth area (UGA) with changes through September 2002. The Comprehensive Plan designates an UGA which includes areas and densities sufficient to permit the urban growth that is projected to occur in the County for the succeeding 20-year period.

Purpose: The Growth Management Act requires the King County Comprehensive Plan to designate an Urban Growth Area; where most future urban growth and development is to occur to limit urban sprawl; enhance open space; protect rural areas and more efficiently use human services; transportation and utilities.
